channel.title: Macwan Apps Blog
channel.description: Notes from an indie iOS studio — launches, lessons, and what it's like building apps solo. By Jobin Macwan.

item.title: Introducing WalkFirst: your steps are the key to your apps
item.description: Why I built an app that blocks distracting apps until you've walked enough — and how Apple's Screen Time framework makes it possible without your data ever leaving your phone.

item.title: Introducing Rockiva: point your camera at a rock, learn what it is
item.description: An AI-powered rock and gem identifier that gives you real mineralogy instead of a guess — localized in 35 languages, including the AI's answers themselves.
